description.text: Training Objective This course is designed to teach Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and mathematics, etc, after one academic year (Fall and Spring Semesters, totally 36 weeks) or one semester (Spring Semester 15-17 weeks) continuous study in “Preparatory Course”, students can finally achieve the entry level of bachelor’s programs (offered in Chinese) at UIBE. In other words, and reach HSK 5-6 in Chinese; pass level of College Entrance Exam in mathematics (for arts students), and College English Test band 3 in English. Courses Offered · Fall Semester: 30 class hours per week (Chinese, request centralism studies by yourself) · Spring Semester: 29 class hours per week (Chinese, request centralism studies by yourself); 3 class hours per week (Mathematics); 3 class hours per week (English) Term Set · March - July for Spring Semester · September – January for Fall Semester: (Note: For exact registration time, please refer to Admission Notice) Application Period · April – June 10 for Fall Semester: · October – November 30for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY 19,800/semester CNY 38,600/academic year · Advance payment of CNY 3,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester

duration.text: The Intensive Preparatory Course for Bachelor Programs at University of International Business and Economics is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5361 USD/per year ￥ 38600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Over age of 18. Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial certificate of guardianship Note: For those who apply for Spring Semester, a copy of HSK Level 3 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 3) organized by UIBE; Those who can not pass will be transferred to study in Elementary Chinese Program. For those who apply for Fall Semester, HSK is not required. Students need to attend a placement test at the beginning of the Semester.
